verdict.rationale: Vue's docs state it builds on standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Multiple community reports corroborate a shallow learning curve: basics in minutes, adept within hours. Users also praise single-file components that separate HTML, JS and styles. However, the first-party evidence is only a tagline, and some users note the template DSL is itself a new syntax to learn, and that Vue does not use standards like custom elements. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how templates and single-file components map to standard HTML/CSS/JS, an answer to the concern that the template DSL adds concepts beyond plain JavaScript.
